description: This file defines a React hook and a utility function for progressive batch processing of items, leveraging requestIdleCallback or setTimeout for non-blocking execution in the frontend. It includes a main utility function 'createProgressiveExpandController' and a React hook 'useProgressiveExpand' to manage batching and progress state.

methods.name: createProgressiveExpandController({ items, applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs = 10, onProgress, onDone, onCancel, })
methods.description: Creates a controller object to process a list of items in batches asynchronously, providing start and cancel controls, progress tracking, and adaptive batching based on total items. Supports requestIdleCallback with a fallback to setTimeout.

methods.name: useProgressiveExpand({ applyBatch, batchSize, timeSliceMs, onDone, onCancel, autoCancelOnUnmount = true, } = {})
methods.description: React hook that wraps the batch processing utility, managing internal UI state such as running status, progress percentage, and processed counts, and exposing functions to start processing from a collection of items or cancel the operation.
